make_head_enn_epinet: create an epinet ENN head for BERT classification with configurable hidden layers and prior scale
make_head_enn_ensemble: build an ensemble ENN head for BERT classification with multiple parallel MLP networks
make_head_enn_dropout: create a dropout ENN head for BERT classification with configurable dropout rate
make_baseline_head_enn: build a baseline classifier head ENN using CommonOutputLayer with PRNG-based indexing
CommonOutputLayer_call: create a BERT finetuning output layer with optional extra projection and dropout for classification
